There are four problem sets. Homework 1 is due Wednesday, August 5, and each
subsequent homework is due one week later. Solutions are released after each
homework's due date.

Homeworks are submitted by pushing to your personal GitHub repository. See
[Submitting Homework](submitting.qmd) to register your GitHub username
and submission instructions.
